Assessment Evaluation & Shortlist Status
Accenture Complete Recruitment Roadmap (Stages 1, 2 & 3)

Stage 1: Online Assessment (OA) - Current Simulator

• Section A (Eliminatory): Gamified Cognitive Challenge + ~50 Behavioral MCQs.
• Section B: 45 Technical MCQs in 45 Minutes (Pseudocode, Cloud, Networks, Security, MS Excel).
• Section C: 3 Coding Questions in 60 Minutes (Frontend DOM/CSS, SQL Multi-table JOINs, Backend DSA).

Stage 2: Communication Assessment (Automated AI Voice Evaluation)

Evaluates spoken English fluency, pronunciation, grammar, and listening comprehension:

  • Reading Aloud: Read displayed corporate sentences clearly with natural cadence.
  • Listening & Repeating: Listen to audio sentences once and repeat them back verbatim.
  • Vocabulary: Give one-word synonyms or complete short phrases based on audio cues.
  • Grammar Questions: Rearrange scrambled sentences or identify correct preposition/verb tenses.
  • Spoken Communication (Extempore): 1-minute impromptu speech on a workplace or general prompt (e.g. "Should companies allow permanent hybrid work?").

Stage 3: Technical + HR Interview (30–45 Minutes)

  • Project Deep Dive: Architecture diagram, tech stack selection rationale, database schema design, and API endpoints.
  • Coding & Core Concepts: OOPs principles, SQL indexing & normalization, RESTful standards, cloud deployment models.
  • Situational & HR Questions: How you resolved team conflicts, handling deadline pressures, aligning with Accenture core values.
